title: Paranoid Woman Spam Calls 911 Before Doing This in Jail
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 26, 2022, police were called to the Comfort Inn and Suites hotel for a disorderly guest in Delavan, WI. A female guest had allegedly called 911 and the front desk multiple times. After police made contact with her, she was placed under arrest because of her behavior. She was then transported to the jail. However, she became very uncooperative when the jail staff tried to get her booked in. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
